title: Mobile SAST static leads (ADR-0010 G6 = A, task V07)
description: Static mobile rule hits from 02-mobile-sast. The node carries its own platform-marker probe (G6 = A); its receipt is outputs/mobile-applicability.json and is a required file of the contract. A rule hit is a rule id, a closed category and a hashed source location: there is no message, snippet or other free text because mobsfscan output embeds raw matched source lines (G9).

job_id.description: The one node that may publish this result.

attempt_id.description: The node attempt; equals tool-results.json, coverage.json and the probe receipt.

marker_present.description: Equals the probe receipt's `applicable` for tool_id.
